title: TRACE Duo Exhibition
summary: Two-artist exhibition at Lander-Se gallery. Free, open daily except Tuesdays and Wednesdays, closing 31 May.
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery visit
editorVerdict: Worth thirty minutes if you're already in the area, paired with MPRG up the road.
editorNote:
A small two-artist show at Lander-Se, the kind of independent gallery the Peninsula does quietly well. Closes 31 May. Free, no booking, open daily except Tuesday and Wednesday.

The honest move is to treat it as the second stop on a Mornington gallery loop: MPRG first, lunch, then TRACE on the way back. Not a destination on its own.
